paper.title: Distributed Online Submodular Maximization under Communication Delays: A Simultaneous Decision-Making Approach

settings.name_in_paper: Distributed Online Submodular Maximization under Communication Delays (Problem 1)
unmapped: Each of N agents picks one action from its own set V_i (partition-matroid joint action); objective f_t is normalized, non-decreasing, submodular and 2nd-order submodular
Each agent observes only marginal gain of its action given its multi-hop in-neighbours' actions, delayed by d_i (radius of its neighbourhood)
Communication network may be directed and disconnected; suboptimality depends on centralization of information (coin) and curvature kappa_f
Rewards normalised to [0,1] by the algorithm; range of f_t not otherwise stated
settings.definition_quote: At each time step $t\in[T]$, given the multi-hop neighborhood $\calN_i$, each agent $i\in\calN$ needs to select an action $a_{i,t}$ to jointly solve $\max \sum_{t=1}^T f_t(\{a_{i,t}\}_{i\in \calN})$ where $f_t$ is a normalized, non-decreasing submodular, and 2nd-order submodular set function, and each agent $i$ can access the value of $f_t(\calA)$ only after it has selected $a_{i,t}$ at time $t$ and received $\{a_{j,t}\}_{j\in \calN_{i}}$ at time $t+d_i$

symbols.V_plus_d: max_i (|V_i| + d_i): action-set size plus communication delay

conditions: approximation factor alpha = 1/(1+kappa_f), with an additional subtracted term kappa_f/(1+kappa_f) * sum_i E[sum_t coin_{f_t,i}(N_i)] (centralization of information)
f_t normalized, non-decreasing, submodular and 2nd-order submodular

source.label: th:main
source.quote: E[sum f_t(A_t)] >= 1/(1+kappa_f) sum f_t(A^OPT) - kappa_f/(1+kappa_f) sum_i E[sum_t coin_{f_t,i}(N_i)] - \Tilde{O}(|N| sqrt(\overline{|V|+d} T))

results.notes: Recorded the additive regret term psi(T) of the approximation guarantee; the multiplicative factor and coin penalty are in conditions. Relies on Thune et al. 2019 Theorem 1 for each agent's delayed-bandit regret.

conditions: f_t normalized, non-decreasing, submodular and 2nd-order submodular

source.label: th:main
source.quote: In particular, when the network is fully centralized, E[sum f_t(A_t)] >= 1/(1+kappa_f) sum f_t(A^OPT) - \Tilde{O}(|N| sqrt(\overline{|V|+d} T))

results.notes: Special case (eq. thm-1) stated after Theorem 1.

conditions: f_t normalized, non-decreasing, submodular and 2nd-order submodular

source.label: th:main
source.quote: When the network is fully decentralized, E[sum f_t(A_t)] >= (1-kappa_f) sum f_t(A^OPT) - \Tilde{O}(|N| sqrt(\overline{|V|+d} T))

results.notes: Special case (eq. thm-2) stated after Theorem 1.

symbols.tau_c: time to transmit one action over one hop

conditions: wall-clock convergence time to epsilon-convergence of the approximation guarantee
results.notes: Convergence time (wall-clock) rather than regret; epsilon is average per-round approximation error.
